questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how fees are computed across charges and refunds? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A standard-plan merchant is charged 10_000 minor units. What feeMinor is recorded?
A merchant fully refunds a charge. Which value is used for the returned fee?
choices: A freshly computed percentage fee on the refund amount
Zero, because fixed fees are never refunded
processingFee recomputed with the merchant's current plan
The feeMinor stored on the original charge entry

questions.prompt: A refund request references a charge that belongs to a different merchant. What happens?
choices: An error is thrown before any ledger entry is written
The refund is recorded against the charge's merchant
The refund is recorded with a zero fee
The refund is recorded but netMinor is left positive
